Administering KoldFusion Server

Troubleshooting

Some common problems and how to fix them.

"Data source X could not be found"

A CFQUERY names a data source that is not registered. Check the spelling of the DATASOURCE attribute (case does not matter), and check the ODBC, Native Drivers and OLE DB pages, or the complete list on Verify Data Source. If the data source exists but verification fails, the message tells you why: the connections may be disabled, or the database directory may be missing. "The SQL operation is restricted" means that Restrict SQL Operations is set for that data source.

Forgotten Administrator password

Stop the server and start it again with a new password:

./bin/kfserver --reset-admin-password newsecret

The password is changed before the server starts, and you can log in with it right away.

The Administrator says "denied access to CFREGISTRY"

The Unsecured Tags Directory on Basic Security no longer covers the Administrator, and a tag it needs has been disabled. Open kfroot/registry/kf.registry in a text editor, find the TagRestrictions key and set the tag back to "1":

[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Allair\KoldFusion\CurrentVersion\Server\TagRestrictions]
"CFREGISTRY"="1"

Save the file. KoldFusion notices the change on the next request.

Restarting the server

Use Restart Server... on the Server Settings page, or stop the server with Ctrl+C and run ./bin/kfserver again. Restart after changing "Limit simultaneous requests". Most other settings take effect immediately.

Changes to a template do not show up

Trusted cache is on. Click Clear Template Cache on the Caching page.

The server restarted by itself

Too many requests hung for more than twice the request timeout. server.log names the stuck templates. Find the slow query or the endless loop, or raise the timeout on the Server Settings page.

Mail does not arrive

Click Verify on the Mail page, check mail.log, fix the problem and click Respool Undeliverable.

Reading the logs

The Log Files page shows every log in the browser, newest entries first. application.log has the details of every error page a visitor saw, including the template and line number.

Port 8500 is already in use

Another server is listening on that port. Start KoldFusion on another one with ./bin/kfserver -p 8501.
